rule: Parse JSON/JSONL, recursively replace any Windows drive:/Users/user-component prefix, including case and short-name aliases (backslash or slash spelling) by <USER_HOME>; serialize UTF-8. No task/response/reward/tool scientific values otherwise changed. Original files retained byte-for-byte.
credential_scan: No Authorization/Bearer/access_token/refresh_token/api_key/apiKey patterns; archive construction fails closed if any present.
absolute_user_path_scan: No drive:/Users path in public copies; fails closed.
